verdict.rationale: GoDaddy is a registrar and DNS host, so DNSSEC is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions DNSSEC, zone signing, or DS record submission to the registry. The docs only cover generic DNS record CRUD, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry
